why: The Ridge is one of the rare retreats in Ubud built entirely for two: five private pool villas on the Sayan Ridge, above the Ayung River valley, with butler service, in-villa spa treatments and a twelve-table restaurant facing the sunset. A MICHELIN Key in 2026 and a 9.8 guest rating on Booking.com say the experience is already at the top of the market.

**Airbnb is the missing channel, and it has proven itself.** It is where couples and honeymooners look for private pool villas in Ubud every day, and it is the channel I know best: ten years as a Superhost, 800 reviews, a 4.8 rating. In September, my own villas in Canggu ran at 80 to 100% occupancy against a market at 29 to 47%. A listing under that profile does not start from zero: it inherits the ranking and the trust from day one, which is what turns a search into a booking.

**Everything you have in place stays. I run in parallel.** Your website, your platforms, your rates and your team do not change. I add channels you are not on today, in line with your rates, and I am only paid on the nights I sell.
closing: My guests book through someone they trust, and they arrive already knowing what makes The Ridge different.
company_note: This matters for a hotel. Working with a compliant local entity protects you and your owners, and every booking I bring is documented properly on both sides.
